newsitem.title: USA: Brazil not spreading auto tariffs to other sectors.
newsitem.headline: Brazil not spreading auto tariffs to other sectors.

text.p: Brazil remains committed to free and open trade and has no intention of spreading controversial tariffs on autos to other sectors, Brazilian Minister of External Relations Luiz Felipe Lampreia said Monday.

"We are not in the process (of turning the clock back) even when we appear to be retrenching as we did in the case of autombiles," he said, adding "We never considered we were going to duplicate (the auto action) in other sectors," he told a U.S. Chamber of Commerce lunch.
He said that rather than returning to protectionist actions of the past, it would be better for the economy to be exposed to global competition.
"We believe the Brazilian economy should grow by being more exposed to this international competition and more inserted into the global marketplace," he said.
